signal_words.DANGER: Hazardous situation that, if not avoided, will result in death or serious injury.
signal_words.WARNING: Hazardous situation that, if not avoided, could result in death or serious injury.
signal_words.CAUTION: Hazardous situation that, if not avoided, could result in minor or moderate injury.
signal_words.NOTICE: Information about practices not related to personal injury, such as property damage (no safety alert symbol).

message_format.basis: ANSI Z535.6 / ISO 3864-2 / ISO 3864-3; ISO 7010 pictogram codes. All message text is original ManualOS wording.

trigger_semantics: triggers describe the PLC/CAD/spec evidence that makes a hazard applicable; the generator should include the entry when any trigger matches and let the user confirm. On product.subsystem_function pages, include only hazards whose triggering evidence (motion component, valve output, heater, etc.) belongs to that subsystem, and reword the hazard source to name the subsystem.

hazards.hazard: Hazardous voltage inside electrical enclosures and terminal boxes.
hazards.consequence: Contact with live parts will cause death or severe burns.
avoidance: Only qualified electrical workers may open the enclosure.
Switch off and lock the main disconnect before opening.
Verify absence of voltage with a rated tester on every conductor before touching.

triggers.spec: supply_voltage > 50 V AC or > 120 V DC

hazards.hazard: Drive and power-supply capacitors stay charged after power is removed.
hazards.consequence: Touching DC bus terminals before discharge will cause death or severe injury.
avoidance: After isolation, wait at least the discharge time printed on the drive label or in the drive manual.
Measure the DC bus before work and confirm it is below the voltage stated on the drive label or in the drive manual.

hazards.hazard: Arc flash and arc blast when working on or near energised equipment.
hazards.consequence: An arc flash can cause fatal burns, blindness and hearing loss.
avoidance: Work de-energised wherever possible.
If live work is unavoidable, follow an energised-work permit and the incident-energy label.
Wear arc-rated PPE matching the label category.

triggers.spec: supply_voltage >= 208 V or available fault current known

hazards.hazard: Circuits supplied from outside the machine remain live when the main disconnect is off.
hazards.consequence: Unexpected contact can cause electric shock.
avoidance: Identify externally supplied circuits by their orange wiring or labels.
Isolate the external source as well before working on them.

hazards.hazard: Automatic restart after a power interruption or fault reset.
hazards.consequence: Machine parts can start moving without warning and cause serious injury.
avoidance: Do not rely on a stopped machine being safe; lock out before entering.
Confirm that auto-restart parameters are disabled unless the risk assessment allows them.

hazards.hazard: Crushing points between moving and fixed parts (axes, clamps, lifts, press tooling).
hazards.consequence: Body parts caught in the gap can be crushed or amputated.
avoidance: Keep hands and body clear of the motion path while the machine is energised.
Use setup mode with reduced speed and an enabling device for close-in work.
Block or lower gravity-loaded parts before reaching in.

triggers.plc: linear axis, cylinder or clamp outputs

hazards.hazard: Sharp tools, blades, knives and cut edges.
hazards.consequence: Contact can cause deep cuts or amputation.
avoidance: Handle tools and blades with cut-resistant gloves.
Use tool holders or guards when changing blades.
Never reach past a guard to remove scrap.

hazards.hazard: Rotating spindles, shafts, rollers, belts, chains and conveyors.
hazards.consequence: Hair, clothing, gloves or jewellery can be drawn in, causing severe injury or death.
avoidance: Keep guards closed while parts rotate.
Tie back long hair; no loose clothing, jewellery or gloves near rotating parts.
Wait for complete standstill before opening guards.

hazards.hazard: Workpieces, tools, chips or broken parts thrown from the machine.
hazards.consequence: Ejected parts can cause eye injury or impact injuries.
avoidance: Keep doors and windows closed during operation.
Replace damaged or aged guard windows at the specified interval.
Clamp workpieces securely and respect chuck/fixture speed limits.

hazards.hazard: Fast, unpredictable robot or manipulator movement inside the safeguarded space.
hazards.consequence: Being struck or trapped by the robot will cause death or serious injury.
avoidance: Do not enter the safeguarded space while the system is in automatic mode.
Teach only in reduced-speed manual mode with an enabling device held by the person inside.
Plan an escape path and stay out of pinch points against fixed objects.

hazards.hazard: Vertical axes, lifted loads and counterweights that can fall when power or brakes are released.
hazards.consequence: A falling load can crush or kill.
avoidance: Mechanically block or lower vertical axes before maintenance.
Never stand under suspended loads.
Test holding brakes at the specified interval.

hazards.hazard: Heavy machine or modules during lifting and transport, including off-centre centre of gravity.
hazards.consequence: Tip-over or a dropped load can cause death or serious injury and damage the machine.
avoidance: Use only the marked lifting points and lifting gear rated for the stated mass.
Fit transport locks before moving.
Keep people out of the lift area.

hazards.hazard: Machine or modules not anchored, or unstable during assembly and dismantling.
hazards.consequence: The machine can tip over and crush people.
avoidance: Anchor the machine as specified before operation.
Follow the stated dismantling order to keep it stable.

triggers.cad: high centre of gravity or unanchored base

hazards.hazard: Fluids, chips, cables and hoses on the floor; work on platforms.
hazards.consequence: Slipping or falling can cause injury.
avoidance: Keep the floor around the machine clean and dry.
Route cables and hoses in trays.
Use approved access platforms and fall protection when working at height.
ppe: fall harness for work at height

hazards.hazard: Hydraulic systems and accumulators remain under pressure after the pump stops.
hazards.consequence: Escaping fluid jets can penetrate skin, and unexpected cylinder movement can crush.
avoidance: Depressurise the system and drain accumulators before opening any connection.
Check the gauge reads zero.
Never search for leaks with your hand.

hazards.hazard: Compressed air in lines, reservoirs and cylinders after the supply is shut off.
hazards.consequence: Sudden movement of cylinders, whipping hoses or flying parts can cause injury.
avoidance: Close and lock the air isolation valve and exhaust residual air before work.
Secure loads held by cylinders.
Never point compressed air at people.

hazards.hazard: Pressure vessels, receivers and oil separators.
hazards.consequence: Rupture of a vessel can cause death or serious injury.
avoidance: Do not exceed the maximum allowable pressure on the vessel plate.
Do not weld or modify pressure parts.
Keep safety valves operable and test them periodically.

triggers.spec: PS x V above directive limit

hazards.hazard: Pre-loaded springs, tensioned belts and counterbalance cylinders.
hazards.consequence: Uncontrolled release can strike or trap body parts.
avoidance: Release spring or belt tension using the specified procedure and tools before disassembly.

hazards.hazard: Hot surfaces on motors, spindles, heaters, compressors, exhausts and hot-melt systems.
hazards.consequence: Touching can cause burns.
avoidance: Allow parts to cool before maintenance.
Wear heat-resistant gloves when work on warm parts is unavoidable.

hazards.hazard: Hot oil, coolant, steam or water under pressure.
hazards.consequence: Spraying hot fluid can cause severe burns and scalds.
avoidance: Isolate and lock the supply before you vent steam, drain hot fluid, or open a fitting.
Let the system cool and depressurise before opening caps or drains.

hazards.hazard: Cryogenic or refrigerated parts.
hazards.consequence: Contact can cause cold burns.
avoidance: Wear insulated gloves when handling cold parts.

hazards.hazard: Noise levels at the workstation above 80 dB(A).
hazards.consequence: Long exposure can cause permanent hearing loss.
avoidance: Wear hearing protection when the declared level exceeds 80 dB(A) or as site rules require.
Keep acoustic covers closed.

hazards.hazard: Hand-arm or whole-body vibration from hand-held tools or platforms.
hazards.consequence: Long exposure can cause circulatory and joint disorders.
avoidance: Limit exposure time and use low-vibration tools.

hazards.hazard: Laser beam in Class 3B or Class 4 laser equipment, including reflected beams.
hazards.consequence: Direct or reflected beams can cause permanent eye damage and skin burns, and ignite materials.
avoidance: Operate only with the laser enclosure closed and interlocks active.
Use laser safety eyewear rated for the wavelength during service alignment.
Only trained laser personnel may service the beam path.

hazards.hazard: Class 2/2M/3R alignment or sensor lasers.
hazards.consequence: Staring into the beam can injure the eye.
avoidance: Do not look into the beam or at reflections.

hazards.hazard: Strong magnetic fields from permanent magnet motors, magnetic chucks, induction heaters or welding.
hazards.consequence: Can interfere with pacemakers and implanted devices; magnets can pinch fingers.
avoidance: Persons with active implants must keep the distance stated by the manufacturer.
Handle permanent magnet rotors only with the specified tools.

triggers.cad: PM motor, magnetic chuck, induction coil

hazards.hazard: UV or intense IR from curing lamps, welding arcs or heaters.
hazards.consequence: Can burn eyes and skin.
avoidance: Keep shields closed; wear filtering eyewear if exposed.

hazards.hazard: Oils, coolants, cleaning agents, adhesives and process chemicals.
hazards.consequence: Skin contact, inhalation of mist or ingestion can cause dermatitis, respiratory problems or poisoning.
avoidance: Read the safety data sheet for each substance before use.
Wear the gloves and eye protection specified in the SDS.
Use extraction where mist or vapour is produced.

hazards.hazard: Dust, fumes or mist produced by the process (machining, welding, grinding, powder).
hazards.consequence: Breathing these can cause lung disease; some dusts can explode.
avoidance: Run the extraction system whenever the process runs.
Wear a respirator where exposure limits may be exceeded.
Keep the area free of dust deposits.

hazards.hazard: Flammable fluids, oil mist, fuel or combustible chips near ignition sources.
hazards.consequence: Fire or explosion can cause death, serious injury and property loss.
avoidance: Use only non-flammable coolant unless a fire suppression system is fitted.
Do not leave the machine unattended while machining flammable materials.
Keep a suitable extinguisher nearby.

hazards.hazard: Inert gases (nitrogen, CO2, argon) or exhaust gas in enclosed spaces.
hazards.consequence: Can cause unconsciousness and death without warning.
avoidance: Ventilate enclosed spaces; use gas monitoring before entry.

hazards.hazard: Manual lifting of parts, tools or change parts heavier than 23 kg or in awkward postures.
hazards.consequence: Can cause back and muscle injuries.
avoidance: Use lifting aids for loads above 23 kg (or local limit).
Lift with two people where aids are not available.

hazards.hazard: Repetitive tasks and poorly positioned controls or displays.
hazards.consequence: Fatigue and errors may lead to damage or injury.
avoidance: Adjust workstation height; rotate tasks.

hazards.hazard: Bypassing, removing or defeating interlocks, guards or safety functions.
hazards.consequence: Exposes people to all machine hazards and will lead to death or serious injury.
avoidance: Never bridge, remove or tamper with safety devices.
Report defective safety devices and take the machine out of service until repaired.

hazards.hazard: Program, parameter or recipe changes, including unauthorised remote changes.
hazards.consequence: The machine may move in unexpected ways and cause injury or damage.
avoidance: Only authorised users may change programs or parameters.
Test changes in reduced speed or dry-run before production.
Protect remote access with user accounts and network segmentation.

hazards.category: reduced protection in manual / setup mode
hazards.hazard: Safeguards partly muted in setup, teach or maintenance mode.
hazards.consequence: Moving parts can reach the operator.
avoidance: Use the enabling device; release it to stop motion.
Only one person in the danger zone controls motion.
Return to automatic only after everyone has left the zone.

hazards.hazard: Wrong supply voltage, phase rotation, air quality, lubricant or fluid.
hazards.consequence: Can damage the machine.
avoidance: Check supply data against the nameplate before connecting.
Use only the specified lubricants and fluids.

hazards.hazard: Electrostatic discharge on electronic modules.
hazards.consequence: Can damage control electronics.
avoidance: Ground yourself before handling boards; use ESD packaging.

hazards.hazard: Contamination of food, beverage or pharmaceutical product by lubricants, foreign bodies or cleaning agents.
hazards.consequence: Contaminated product can harm consumers.
avoidance: Use only food-grade (H1) lubricants where specified.
Follow the cleaning plan and verify cleanliness before restart.
